parts.text: In this experiment, you will determine the focal length f of a lens. Carry out the following instructions referring to Fig. 3.1. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) • Place the screen about 100 cm from the illuminated object. • Place the lens between the object and the screen so that the centre of the lens is at a distance u 1 = 20.0 cm from the object. • Adjust the position of the screen until a clearly focused image is formed on the screen.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Measure the distance v 1 between the centre of the lens and the screen. v 1 = .......................................................... [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the focal length f 1 of the lens using the equation f 1 = u 1 v 1 ( u 1 + v 1 ) . f 1 = .......................................................... [1]

ms.label: 3(a)(ii)
ms.text: value for f in range 14 to 16 (cm)

parts.label: i
parts.text: (b) (i) Repeat the procedure in (a) , placing the lens between the object and the screen so that the centre of the lens is at a distance u 2 = 30.0 cm from the object. v 2 = .......................................................... [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the focal length f 2 of the lens using the equation f 2 = u 2 v 2 ( u 2 + v 2 ) . f 2 = .......................................................... [2]

ms.label: 3(b)(ii)
